messages:
alex: Heads-up — we should lock the scope for the ISV/tooling sprint next week. Focus: LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters, gateway contract, and orchestration samples. Who can surface gaps by EOD?
rita: I'll take LangChain + LlamaIndex compatibility. Quick checklist: auth flows, streaming API signatures, and sample prompts. Anything else? :thinking_face:
sam: I'll own gateway adapter contract + CI matrix (python/node/java). Need to know supported runtimes for our gateway (edge vs managed).
jordan: Marketing/partner comms note — co-announcement window is tight. If engineering needs >2 weeks for docs + samples we should push announce. @alex can you confirm timeline? :calendar:
marie: Demo infra question: do partners get sandbox creds or do we use ephemeral tokens via our demo harness? Need to provision a shared sandbox for the week of the sprint.
paul: Re: adapter contract — here's the minimal interface we used for the FlowBridge POC:```
# adapter interface sketch
class Adapter:
    def __init__(self, config):
        pass
    def stream(self, prompt, on_token):
        """Yields tokens and metadata"""
    def embed(self, documents):
        return [float]  # vector list
```
paul: We'll iterate, but this covers streaming + embed surface. Keep error codes stable (429, 503, 400).
rita: Also add a small eval harness (100 prompts) to catch model drift between variants — partners often hit quality regressions after quantized builds. Sam — can we wire that into CI?
sam: Yes. Plan: CI runs smoke + eval on PR against pinned model version; fails if Rouge/BLEU degrade by X. Need the eval set from partnerships team.
alex: Jordan — if we aim for announce on May 18, eng needs final samples + docs by May 3 (two-week buffer). Is that acceptable for partner comms?
jordan: Might be tight for marketplace listing approvals. I'll ask legal/PMM for expedited review but expect 3–5 business days once assets are in. Recommend announce target May 25 to be safe.
marie: Sandbox update — infra can create a tenant with limited GPU quota. @engbot can you spin up a sandbox and post creds?
engbot: deploy-bot: Sandbox tenant "tooling-sprint-2524" created. Admin creds uploaded to 1Password (shared folder: Partnerships/Sprints). PR for terraform: https://git.internal/r/redwood/sandboxes/pulls/432
rita: For LangChain adapter, note: function-calling hooks differ slightly — we should provide adapter examples for both legacy chain/agent flows and the new tool-calling API. I'll draft samples.
paul: Question: do we want to support model fallback routing in the adapter (e.g., low-cost quantized -> higher-quality full model)? That affects signature (we might need health check + variant hints).
alex: Good call. Add health-check endpoint + supported-variants metadata. Sam, add to contract doc.
sam: Will do. I'll post a proto-API doc tomorrow AM.
jordan: I'll draft release blurb + partner checklist so PMM/legal know assets needed.
marie: Final ask — who will be the on-call during the sandbox demo week? We should rotate SRE/infra on-call with one eng from partnerships.
paul: I'll take first two days, then alex or sam can cover handoff.
alex: Thanks all. Action items: Rita (LangChain samples + eval), Sam (gateway contract + CI), Paul (adapter proto + on-call), Jordan (marketplace/comm windows), Marie (sandbox creds), Engbot (infra PR). Please update thread when items are posted. :thumbsup:
